message.content:
This is a knit bralette of 67% nylon and 33% spandex, which falls under heading 6212 (brassieres) if it is a brassiere. A knit bralette with cups is generally classified in 6212.10 as a brassiere. CBP rulings treat knit bralettes with foam cups as brassieres under 6212.10.90, and the HTS 6212.10.90 subdivisions are 6212.10.9010 for the statistical suffix for those of man-made fibers, so I need to check the structure.

HTSUS 6212.10: Brassieres. 6212.10.10 is "Containing 5 percent or more by weight of lace, net or embroidery", 6212.10.20 is "Other: Of cotton", 6212.10.30 "Other: Of man-made fibers" with 6212.10.9010 being the one for the rest. Current HTS has 6212.10.10 (lace/net/embroidery, with 6212.10.1010 for those of cotton, 6212.10.1020 for those of man-made fibers), and 6212.10.90 (Other), with 6212.10.9010 for those of man-made fibers.

Mesh is not lace, net, or embroidery in this case, so I am using 6212.10.90. The statistical suffix 10 is for "Other" and 6212.10.9020 is for others, but I believe the "Other" suffix is 6212.10.9020 for "Of cotton" and 6212.10.9010 for "Of man-made fibers", and 6212.10.9030 for "Other".

I'll go with 6212.10.9010.
